G001.target_statement: Connect with colleagues and former classmates on LinkedIn to see what they are up to.
G001.label: direct
G001.rationale: 原句明确列出在 LinkedIn 上做的事包括 networking、连接同事与过去同学并查看其近况，主体、对象与目的一致。
supported_parts: 连接同事与同学的动作

G002.target_statement: Run marketing on LinkedIn to obtain exposure that is far better than Google Ads, Facebook or other channels in the stakeholder's field.
G002.label: direct
G002.rationale: 原文明确说‘We do a lot of marketing’并把 LinkedIn 的曝光与 Google ads、Facebook 等渠道作比较，认定前者更好；主体、渠道与结果均保留。
supported_parts: 曝光优于其他渠道的判断

G003.target_statement: Recruit through LinkedIn to source many candidates at a cost that is fairly low compared with competitors.
G003.label: direct
G003.rationale: 原句明确说通过 LinkedIn 大量招聘、来源广且相对竞争者成本低；T015 的 Laravel/Lara Jobs 例外已作为条件保留，不改变一般招聘目标。

G004.target_statement: Browse job openings for himself on LinkedIn and check salary ranges from time to time.
G004.label: direct
G004.rationale: 原句‘looking for jobs for myself ... see what some of the salary ranges’表达查看外部机会与薪资范围的意愿，保留‘sometimes / nice to’的弱强度。

G005.target_statement: Check community events posted on LinkedIn when he has the availability and bandwidth, since email alone makes it impossible to keep up.
G005.label: direct
G005.rationale: 原句说明在有空闲与带宽时会上 LinkedIn 查看社区活动，并给出邮件太多无法兼顾的理由；条件与理由均保留。

G006.target_statement: Maintain a credible LinkedIn profile with credentials, degrees and a photo matching his real appearance, so that clients can confirm he is genuine and not a scammer.
G006.label: direct
G006.rationale: 原句明确把资料页当作向客户示意身份与资历、供人核验其非诈骗的资源，属维持型目标；照片与本人一致等细节保留。

G007.target_statement: Use LinkedIn's easy, user-friendly posting tools, including paid recommendations, to put broad-based marketing in front of a targeted audience.
G007.label: inferred
G007.rationale: 原文只陈述工具易用、适合广泛而有针对性的营销，未直接说‘我要用这些工具’；结合其持续营销的正向依据可推断方式选择，故记 inferred。
reasoning_steps: 原文正面评价发帖与推荐工具
推断以其作为实现方式

G008.target_statement: Prefer LinkedIn Learning for quick deep dives into a technology stack or a marketing practice, because its quality exceeds YouTube and similar resources.
G008.label: direct
G008.rationale: 原句‘I did like ... one of the better places to go ... quality would definitely exceed ... YouTube’直接表达对 e-learning 内容的偏好及质量理由；属偏好型目标，未升级为强制。
supported_parts: 用于快速深入了解技术栈或营销做法
质量优于 YouTube 的偏好理由

G009.target_statement: Publish marketing or awareness posts about events such as conferences, as the company and/or personal profile, with images, videos or other visual additions.
G009.label: direct
G009.rationale: 原文以‘Typically what we'll do is ... post something about it’描述会议现场发营销/曝光帖的固定做法，并说明公司/个人主页切换与图片视频等做法；方式与情境保留。

G010.target_statement: Schedule posts for about 9 AM the next morning when people first arrive at the office, instead of posting in the evening, to get more impressions.
G010.label: direct
G010.rationale: 原文明确说要改为次日上午 9 点定时发布、晚上发布曝光更少；时间、理由与预期结果一致。

G011.target_statement: Gain interactions once a post is on the feed and, hopefully, eventually win some business.
G011.label: direct
G011.rationale: 原句说发布后会开始获得互动，并‘hopefully, eventually win some business’；保留希望强度，未写成承诺或指标。

G012.target_statement: Before connecting with a new prospect, search the person's profile and review the background for common threads, and avoid cold calls or cold connection requests.
G012.label: direct
G012.rationale: 原文明确说明只联系认识的人、不做 cold call/cold add；对目标公司的 C-level 会先搜索资料、看背景找共同点再决定是否添加。动作、对象与否定均保留。

G013.target_statement: Have LinkedIn provide more automated support for content development so that a smaller marketing team is needed.
G013.label: direct
G013.rationale: 原文在被问及希望增加或修改什么时明确回答内容开发支持、希望更多自动化，以减少对大型营销团队的需要；建议强度保留。

G014.target_statement: Be able to post professional-looking content without six rounds of review or going through the whole marketing-funnel approval process.
G014.label: direct
G014.rationale: 原文明确希望不必被评审 6 次、不必走完整营销漏斗就能发布专业外观的内容，并说明设计耗时是原因；强度与条件保留。
supported_parts: 免去六轮评审与营销漏斗
